decisions.reason: As an incremental modular development of an already well-accepted trommel screen, it rests on very strong existing screening knowledge and is therefore easy for the firm to support and improve.

The mobile high-speed flail shredders remain close to the firm's core mobile recycling machinery competences, so its production, service, and field-learning capabilities make continued refinement more likely than withdrawal.

Although somewhat less proven than the firm's most established lines, the mobile high-speed grinder is still strongly related to existing mobile processing know-how, and lessons from the withdrawn green-waste variant should improve the firm's ability to focus and develop the stronger core models.

The stationary single-shaft pre-shredders fit the firm's established shredding and plant-engineering knowledge base very well, giving it high absorptive capacity to adapt the line to customer requirements rather than exit it.
